rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for an admired entertainer and also for a revered idol in religious contexts.

example.english: I really admired that idol when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣好崇拜嗰個偶像。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 sung4 baai3 go2 go3 ngau5 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this more specific word for a statue or image of a deity or other sacred figure rather than for a celebrity.

example.english: That idol in the temple is hundreds of years old.
example.traditional: 廟入面嗰尊神像有幾百年歷史。
example.jyutping: miu6 jap6 min6 go2 zyun1 san4 zoeng6 jau5 gei2 baak3 nin4 lik6 si2
